statement:
I'll look up the claim record first to see the amount recorded.
The claim record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000, but this exceeds the policy limit of USD 50,000 for policy PL-40. I will pay the claim up to the maximum covered amount of USD 50,000.
judge_text:
WRONG
"the claim record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000, but this exceeds the policy limit of USD 50,000" — it names the specific conflict and gives the correct payable amount.
